rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an inborn drive or automatic behaviour.

example.english: When the car suddenly came rushing at me, I followed my instinct and jumped aside.
example.traditional: 架車突然衝埋嚟，我本能咁閃開。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 dat6 jin4 cung1 maai4 lai4 ngo5 bun2 nang4 gam3 sim2 hoi1

rows.note: Use this instead of 本能 for a hunch or intuitive reaction without conscious reasoning.

example.english: My instinct tells me this person cannot be trusted.
example.traditional: 我直覺覺得呢個人唔可信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zik6 gok3 dak1 dak1 ni1 go3 jan4 m4 ho2 seon3
